headline: London 1-Bed Rents to Hit £2,335 Within a Year

cards.title: Scarce Rental Supply
cards.text: News headlines track falling supply and record rents, with net supply pressure at 0.053 as Elizabeth line demand surges.

cards.title: London Rent Trajectory
cards.text: Average 1-bed flat rents rise from £2,250 today to £2,260 in six months, reaching £2,335 in 12 months.

cards.title: Lock In Now
cards.text: Sign a tenancy now. With a 61.1% probability of increases over six months, waiting will lead to higher monthly costs.
